scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:images
scripts.build:css: npx tailwindcss -i src/css/main.css -o dist/css/tailwind.tmp.css --minify && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const tw=fs.readFileSync('dist/css/tailwind.tmp.css');const custom=fs.readFileSync('assets/styles.css');fs.writeFileSync('dist/css/styles.min.css',tw+'\n'+custom);fs.unlinkSync('dist/css/tailwind.tmp.css');console.log('Combined CSS: '+(tw.length+custom.length)+' bytes')"
